dedupe_keys.name: national ground water monitoring network ngwmn data portal

description: The National Ground-Water Monitoring Network portal brings together groundwater data held in separate federal, state and local databases so that they can be found in one web map. The US Geological Survey runs it for the federal Subcommittee on Ground Water, and the page read on 2026-09-29 reports ten subnetworks covering several principal aquifers. It offers current and historical water levels, water quality, lithology and well construction for monitoring wells, retrieved through a web mapping application. Coverage is national at well level and time steps depend on the contributing agency. Access is free through the portal; the page does not state a licence, data formats or an update schedule. Caveats: quality and record length vary between subnetworks and web service endpoints are not described on the page read. It suits resilience and drought adaptation studies that need aquifer levels next to drinking water and irrigation infrastructure, and calibration of groundwater models. No closely related catalogue record was identified in this pass.
